page: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server configured with eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs providing a total of 320 GB of VRAM. The host system is powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor with 96 dedicated vCPUs, corresponding to 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system operates at a base clock speed of 2.2 GHz and includes 680.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.08 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by exceptional parallel processing and memory throughput alongside modest single-core capabilities. While single-core metrics in stress-ng and Geekbench fall into the bottom 25%, multi-core CPU performance is strong, placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only cached small block speeds reaching 4215.1 GB/sec and uncached large block reads at 219.95 GB/sec. The server demonstrates top-tier performance in LLM inference, particularly in prompt processing across small, medium, and large models, as well as text generation for 7B and 70B models.

Given the high density of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and substantial memory capacity, this server represents a specialized hardware profile optimized for resource-intensive parallel computing. The absence of local storage means storage configurations must be managed externally. The instance is highly suited for deep learning, large language model inference, heavy ray tracing, and massive multi-threaded scientific simulations, whereas it is inefficient for single-threaded tasks that do not leverage its GPU array.
description: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for massive parallel workloads. It features eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs with 320 GB of total VRAM, paired with an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor offering 96 dedicated vCPUs and 680.0 GB of system memory. While single-core CPU benchmarks are relatively weak, the server delivers strong multi-core performance and exceptional memory bandwidth, with read speeds up to 4215.1 GB/sec. It excels in LLM inference, achieving top-tier token processing speeds for medium and large models. No local storage is bundled, highlighting a design focused purely on compute and memory density. This server is best suited for deep learning, large-scale AI inference, and complex multi-threaded simulations.
